decisionRule: GO needs independent real-binary gains beyond a safe deterministic alternative, zero unsafe strong promotion, and acceptable hard-case latency. A forced-choice win on a generated remembered-name label is not a production rescue.

uses.name: query interpretation and intent decomposition
uses.deterministic: A BattleCats-selected lexical rule gives 152/196, but exploits the common last-two-token query generator
uses.jev: Label-only forced preference gives 92/196: 46 wrong-to-correct, 7 correct-to-wrong; this confounds interpretation with ranking
uses.oracle: 426/426 candidate oracle on existing queries; independent intent labels absent
uses.reason: The phrase alone does not identify the hidden benchmark class or field in many cases. Structured type/read-write/unit constraints have no independent ground truth in this corpus.
uses.nextEvidence: Collect independently phrased user intents with object context and expected semantic constraints.

uses.name: bounded semantic candidate expansion
uses.baseline: 426/426 truth candidates present on latest main
uses.deterministic: #9437 lexical recall lane closed all measured misses
uses.jev: No possible additional recall on this denominator; synonyms were not presented as binary facts
uses.reason: A new paraphrase corpus could create a new denominator; this result only closes the measured remembered-name set.
uses.nextEvidence: Independent paraphrase and gameplay terminology holdout, bounded 64-hypothesis cap, binary existence check.

uses.name: candidate ranking
uses.baseline: 53/196 partial top1; 143 partial wrong and 1 exact wrong
uses.deterministic: 152/196 after BattleCats-selected lexical rule; 103 rescues and 4 regressions, but generator-biased
uses.oracle: Arbitrary hidden-truth candidate oracle 196/196; recorded-evidence safe-direction diagnostic has 0 robust truth differentials among 144 wrong
uses.reason: Evidence and class context worsen this API's forced-choice results. No live answer supports a safe strong verdict; self-rated uniqueness never reaches 0.9.
uses.nextEvidence: Independent user-intent holdout and calibrated hard-case predicate; re-evaluate against a non-generator-trained deterministic reranker.

uses.name: current Pinpoint evidence probe scheduler
uses.jev: No live scheduler run: same-budget oracle leaves zero resolved gap over H6
uses.reason: Jev cannot exceed the finite catalog oracle for these 61 cases.
uses.nextEvidence: A new receiver-proven read/write primitive, then independent catalog and oracle.

uses.name: broader evidence acquisition planning
uses.baseline: 29/105 top1 correct; 76/105 wrong among current ambiguous partial rows with >=2 candidates
uses.deterministic: H6 on the broadened catalog resolves 2/105 (438 analysis calls; p50 6, p95 6)
uses.jev: No Jev scheduler call; the deterministic H6 result is already equal to both measured scheduler oracles
uses.oracle: budget 31/105 top1 and 2 resolved; unbounded 31/105 and 2 resolved; resolved gap 0
uses.reason: The broadened receiver-safe catalog still has no oracle-only resolution: 51 rows are analysis-primitive missing, 6 binary-evidence insufficient, and 17 other catalog-relative cases.
uses.nextEvidence: Add a new receiver-proven read/write or type-propagation primitive, then repeat the same 105-row holdout with a newly frozen oracle. The remaining 39 wrong-but-strong rows are not scheduler-eligible under the fail-closed policy.

uses.name: C++ class, RTTI, virtual dispatch semantics
uses.baseline: #9447 compiler-produced ARM64 ELF variants already recover proven RTTI, vtable extent and member types; open #9469 at head 6d31d638a7102cd48316bc70a3822a858e3a3ddd carries canonical member evidence into a report
uses.deterministic: RTTI/vtable/closure must remain binary-proven; no Jev inference authority
uses.jev: No live call for proof obligations; semantic role tested separately under F
uses.oracle: No independent real-game semantic role oracle
uses.reason: #9469 still reports a missing worker-side producer lifecycle and constructor IR-binding gap; these are reachability/analysis issues, not semantic judgment problems.
uses.nextEvidence: Measure unnamed member role on stripped real-game C++ with independent semantic labels.

uses.name: field role and semantic naming
uses.baseline: #9447 type facts are width/category only; open #9469 at head 6d31d638a7102cd48316bc70a3822a858e3a3ddd projects six typed member observations per compiler fixture, rejects missing offsets, and still mints no semantic names
uses.deterministic: On 5 evidence-supported compiler fields: 3/5 local, 4/5 cross-function
uses.jev: On the same 5: 2/5 local, 4/5 cross-function; two unsupported fields remained unknown or merely descriptive
uses.oracle: 5/5 source labels are known; 2/7 roles are not distinguishable from the shown binary facts
uses.reason: Small source-derived fixture, direct method-symbol cues and no real-game unnamed-field truth. Jev added no net recovery over deterministic cues.
uses.nextEvidence: Stripped field_XX holdout with independently traced use sites, source-hidden labels, and calibrated hypothesis-only UI evaluation.

uses.name: cross-function semantic reasoning
uses.baseline: Five source-labeled compiler fields with enough shown binary facts; two ambiguous controls
uses.deterministic: Method-name/operation cues improve 3/5 local to 4/5 cross-function
uses.jev: 2/5 local to 4/5 cross-function, equal to deterministic cross-function
uses.oracle: 5/5 source labels, but two excluded cases cannot be justified by current evidence
uses.reason: Cross-function context helps the model, but available named methods give a cheap deterministic explanation.
uses.nextEvidence: Real stripped binaries with decrement/refill/clamp/UI/serialization chains and no semantic method names.

uses.name: failure explanation and next-analysis guidance
uses.baseline: #9464 classifies 22 primitive-missing, 6 insufficient-evidence and 12 other among focused cases
uses.deterministic: The same reason codes and probe availability are machine-derivable
uses.jev: No live explanatory text test: SystemOne is typed choice/noul/score, and no independent user-value or next-step success oracle exists
uses.oracle: 59/61 unresolved after all current catalog probes
uses.reason: A model could paraphrase failure codes, but no measured unique decision or user benefit is established.
uses.nextEvidence: Blinded analyst study comparing deterministic reason templates with model guidance and successful follow-up actions.

uses.name: parser, lifter, function extent, code repair
uses.baseline: Historical unsupported-semantics report identifies 320 DT_INIT/DT_FINI extent gaps, not current 426 field-query errors
uses.deterministic: Loader tags and executable-section windows give the grounded follow-up; #9447 reachability and function-discovery gaps also have structural causes
uses.jev: No call: a typed judgment API cannot prove bytes, extent or compile repaired code
uses.oracle: Not applicable to semantic choice without a binary verifier
uses.reason: Jev preference cannot create missing parser/lifter/extent authority.
uses.nextEvidence: Repair deterministic analysis and remeasure; only then screen any residual semantic ambiguity.
